tagline.en: UniDepth V2 — a monocular metric depth estimator used as a geometry prior, predicting real-scale depth from a single image.
tagline.zh: UniDepth V2——用作几何先验的单目度量深度估计器，从单张图像预测真实尺度的深度。

en: UniDepth V2 estimates depth from a single image. Beyond relative depth, it predicts metric depth — depth in real-world scale — which makes it suitable as a geometry prior that other parts of a pipeline can build on.

In WorldFoundry it is exposed as an independent geometry prior through a shared geometry-prior contract, so a depth or point-cloud output can feed downstream 3D and 4D tasks. The default checkpoint is a ViT-L/14 backbone, resolved from Hugging Face or from a local path you provide.
In WorldFoundry you enable it as a prior — give it an image, and it produces the depth estimate and can export the corresponding points.
zh: UniDepth V2 从单张图像估计深度。它不仅给出相对深度，还预测度量深度——即真实世界尺度的深度——因此很适合用作几何先验，供 pipeline 中其他环节在其之上构建。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它通过统一的几何先验契约作为独立几何先验暴露出来，深度或点云输出可供下游 3D 与 4D 任务使用。默认 checkpoint 采用 ViT-L/14 骨干，可从 Hugging Face 解析或由你提供本地路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把它作为先验启用——给它一张图像，它就会产出深度估计，并能导出对应的点。

whenToUse.en: When you need metric (real-scale) monocular depth from a single image as a geometry prior for downstream 3D or 4D pipelines.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从单张图像获得度量（真实尺度）单目深度、并作为下游 3D 或 4D pipeline 的几何先验时。

notFor.en: Commercial use — the upstream release is CC-BY-NC-4.0, so respect the non-commercial terms when enabling this prior. It is a depth estimator, not a generator.
notFor.zh: 不适合商业用途——上游发布采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0，启用该先验时请遵守其非商业条款。它是深度估计器，而非生成模型。
